visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera pans across the interior of a brightly lit retail store decorated extensively with "Back to the Future" themed banners, posters, and hanging decorations. Blue neon LED strips outline the product shelves which are filled with toys, clocks, and accessories. (2) A hand reaches into a plastic bin filled with small, black-packaged "Bath Ball" items and picks one up to show the front design featuring the Hill Valley courthouse. (3) The shot shifts to a glass display case containing a highly detailed gold and black "Chogokin Time Train" model with small figurines of characters beside it. (4) Panning shots reveal rows of themed apparel, including navy blue varsity jackets with white sleeves and lightning bolt motifs, and black satin bombers with the movie logo on the back. (5) A man with long black hair, wearing a black graphic t-shirt, holds a specialized gold-colored DeLorean car model in its yellow 40th-anniversary packaging. He looks directly into the camera lens with an exaggerated expression of shock and excitement. (6) The man unrolls three distinct large movie posters representing the three films in the trilogy, holding them up one by one against a grey wooden wall. (7) A close-up shows a blue spherical bath ball dissolving rapidly in a hand held over clear water, eventually revealing a miniature silver DeLorean toy sitting in the palm.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A grand orchestral BGM starts immediately with triumphant brass fanfares and fast-paced string ostinatos. The sound is cinematic and reminiscent of a classic adventure film score. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX marks a visual cut, while the music maintains its high-energy tempo and rhythmic drive. (3) Orchestral percussion hits emphasize key visual reveals of merchandise, providing a synchronous pulse to the fast editing rhythm. (4) The music continues without interruption, featuring a rising harmonic progression that creates a sense of wonder and excitement. (5) A subtle liquid bubbling or fizzing sound effect is mixed low under the swelling orchestral finale as a bath ball dissolves, followed by a final triumphant brass chord.
